purpose: Test if the unresolved Repair20 active shift residual is caused by using separately PCHIP-interpolated frozen H1 state and derivative arrays off the original Nt64 nodes. Recompute the already-certified reduced H1 equations on Nt64 and Nt128, then rerun the unchanged H3 source, Repair18 boundary and Repair07 canonical propagation and evaluate shift convergence on one common matched physical grid.

on_shell_H1_parent.background: same Repair13 self-consistent reduced AeST+dust+Lambda background independently evaluated on Nt64 and Nt128
on_shell_H1_parent.reference_initial_data: same frozen GE15/GE18 first-order bridge used by Repair13 on each target grid
on_shell_H1_parent.solver: same frozen Repair07 solve_reduced_h1_case_canonical used by Repair13
on_shell_H1_parent.Lambda_c1: same frozen Repair11 first-directional Lambda operator
on_shell_H1_parent.Nt64_reproduction: new Nt64 on-shell H1 must reproduce frozen Repair13 Nt64 Z10 and Z10dot
on_shell_H1_parent.Nt128: genuine on-shell solve; no PCHIP replacement for the H1 state or derivative

interpolated_parent_counterfactual.construct: also reconstruct the Repair20 Nt128 PCHIP(Z10_Nt64) and PCHIP(Z10dot_Nt64) parent without propagating it as the main Repair21 result
interpolated_parent_counterfactual.purpose: quantify the off-shell common-parent approximation used only by Repair20

H3_nonchanges.boundary: same frozen Repair18 q0=0 projected-p0 rule reconstructed separately on Nt64 and Nt128
H3_nonchanges.integrator: same frozen Repair07 two-stage Radau IIA canonical march

matched_shift_diagnostic.coarse_mapping: PCHIP-interpolate Nt64 shift metric, absolute residual and natural scale to the Nt128 grid independently for each fixed C,beta,m
matched_shift_diagnostic.active_mask: defined only from Nt128 on-shell natural scale: scale128 > sqrt(machine_epsilon_float64)*S_ref_Nt128
matched_shift_diagnostic.matched_active_Linf: maximum shift metric over the same Nt128 active mask for Nt64-interpolated and Nt128 fields
matched_shift_diagnostic.matched_active_L2: root-mean-square shift metric over the same Nt128 active mask for Nt64-interpolated and Nt128 fields
matched_shift_diagnostic.observed_order: log(error64/error128)/log(h64/h128), separately for matched Linf and L2
matched_shift_diagnostic.near_null_absolute_residual_over_Sref: Nt128 maximum near-null absolute residual divided by S_ref_Nt128

routing.INTERPOLATED_H1_PARENT_DEFECT_CONFIRMED: on-shell H1 gates pass; on-shell H3 Nt128 active shift <=1e-6; matched Linf and L2 orders >=2.5; state/linear/anisotropy/boundary/near-null gates pass
routing.ACTIVE_SHIFT_ISSUE_PERSISTS_ON_ON_SHELL_: on-shell H1 gates pass but one or more on-shell H3 active-shift/convergence gates fail
routing.IMPLEMENTATION_FAIL: frozen provenance, H1 reproduction, source reconstruction, boundary reconstruction or execution fails

interpretation_boundary: Repair21 is diagnostic only. Positive routing does not relabel Repair19 or certify Z20; a later separately preregistered certification run would still be required.
